quotes.title: HD 18742
quotes.card: HD 18742 is an 8th-magnitude subgiant star located about 530 light-years (160 pc) away in the constellation of Eridanus.
quotes.introduction: It is orbited by one confirmed exoplanet, super-Jupiter HD 18742 b, and possibly by another Jovian planetary candidate.
